### 2026-10-07 – # SO!! I MADE A VERY CUTE-SY Schematic today!!

**3h**

# SO!! I MADE A VERY CUTE-SY Schematic today!!

Well it is cute and functional!

This will be my new and improved macropad, my forth design from scratch!

Features Of This Hackpad:-

+ 9 keys(not too many not too less)
+ 0.91" OLED
+ Backlighting with sk6812 mini-e
+ XIAO RP2060 based

### 2026-10-08 – Did layout and completed routing!

**4h**

Did layout and completed routing!

So I finally did the routing of the macropad it was pretty easy, for the ground pour i just had to pop a few grounding via to connect disconnected parts of the ground plane and it was done!

It was easy enough though i had to design my own iteration of the sk6812 mini-e footprint to fit the LCSC documentation.  Next up is DRC and some silkscreen art!!

### 2026-10-10 – # Case: CADing time!

**3.5h**

# Case: CADing time!

- A design guide for semi-complex plates in-case you wanna do the same process

Well keyboard layout editor is good for most macropads and keyboards. But the way that i make my plate is pretty different.

Delete all of the routing, ground pour and most of the components(diodes, MCU & neopixles)

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/CNJdyyJ4I8fzZ0Pr2VdvErZElnDPPMWi/c508dbe3fb120e72d253cc57c03958ff516da6e6c8b7ffe5cab9a062a7b06bcb.png)

 Keep the components that require a cut out.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/CNJdyyJ4I8fzZ0Pr2VdvErZElnDPPMWi/90d1cec30327021ca5fe2f6e94821c2f1fc872466c7d6beefc3ffb960dcefb49.png)

Draw 14.2mm squares around all the mx switches. For displays follow [this image](https://www.winstar.com.tw/uploads/editor/images/oled-module/graphic-oled-display/WEA012832F.jpg)  and figure out the dimensions according to your liking. P.S: These shapes should be in edge.cut layer. Delete the components. Now it should looks something like this:

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/CNJdyyJ4I8fzZ0Pr2VdvErZElnDPPMWi/9122e5c8a16bc2b95cfb19121b876806fb0bdc1cb8a27328e5c5e475ec292b2b.png)

Now we have to export this! Follow these steps:

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/CNJdyyJ4I8fzZ0Pr2VdvErZElnDPPMWi/3cd16d1db6b97de7773020f92d0a9a38dd98f48cb25d8394a8af13c1397cfdc4.png)

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/CNJdyyJ4I8fzZ0Pr2VdvErZElnDPPMWi/e15b9c039a6930693b2d80c38ac96b72b74c70d33ccdc451a3d3c76c7bf0ec86.png)

Now use this DXF file in your cad to get the plate!

- Case is done and dusted!

It was easy enough I added 1mm clearance to each side, added an angel of 4deg to make using it easier. Added screw holes for m3 screws and inserts. Now it looks like this!

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/CNJdyyJ4I8fzZ0Pr2VdvErZElnDPPMWi/17ad0258e1d75730496b32d99c435aa7b197a8c9de38a589af73f354e0da536c.png)
